results.name: game_engine_koth_player_in_hill_bounds
results.evidence: Resolves a player index (in_EAX) to its object, compares object z (offset 0xa8) against hill z-bounds _DAT_006b1060/_DAT_006b105c, then calls polygon2d_point_inside_margin on the object's xy position and DAT_006b0f50.
results.summary: Given a player index passed in EAX, tests whether the player's object lies within the current King-of-the-Hill zone's 2D polygon and vertical z-bounds.

results.name: game_engine_koth_player_tick_update
results.evidence: Clears queued player-event fields (+0x74/+0x78), calls FUN_0046aa60 (in-hill test) and, when true, credits per-team hill time (DAT_006b0ec0), fires FUN_0046be40(1) at fixed remaining-time thresholds (900/0x708 ticks), and calls game_engine_begin_end_game_sequence() once a team's target (DAT_006f1ce0*0x708) is reached.
results.summary: Per-tick handler for a King-of-the-Hill player: if the player is validly standing in the hill and the game is not already decided, credits hill time to their team, fires countdown/warning sound cues near the win threshold, and starts the end-of-game sequence when the team's target hill-time is reached.

results.name: game_engine_koth_update_hill_occupancy_state
results.evidence: Iterates all active players/objects via data_iterator_next twice, counting those flagged in-hill (DAT_006c0f3f) and classifying control into DAT_006b1050 (empty/single/team/contested), tracking a streak counter DAT_006b1054 that triggers FUN_0046be40(1) once it reaches 300 ticks.
results.summary: Determines each tick whether the hill is empty, held by a single player/team, or contested, updates the hill-control state machine, and plays a notification sound once a control streak reaches five seconds (300 ticks).

results.name: game_engine_koth_reset_hill_marker_queue
results.evidence: Copies the same 3-float base vector from PTR_DAT_00686b04 into four consecutive 0xc-byte position slots (DAT_0087a9a0..0087a9cc) and zeroes the trailing four dwords (0087a9d0..dc).
results.summary: Resets the moving-hill marker position history/queue by seeding all four tracked slots with the current hill location and clearing their associated counters.

results.name: game_engine_koth_submit_hill_marker_geometry
results.evidence: Builds a 4-entry vertex/geometry batch from an input array (in_EAX) keyed by an object-type definition (DAT_0087bc14 table), fills default color/material data from PTR_DAT_00686b04/PTR_DAT_006851fc/PTR_DAT_00686b0c or the hill queue set up by FUN_0046b250 (DAT_0087a9a0/0087a9d0) when params are null, then issues the draw via FUN_0052b050/FUN_0052b180.
results.summary: Assembles and submits a small render/decal geometry batch (positions, colors, default hill-marker placement) to draw the moving King-of-the-Hill marker.

results.name: game_engine_koth_report_hill_times
results.evidence: param_1==0 requests the current network state via FUN_004ec940(0,0x13,...); nonzero averages the per-team hill-tick counters (DAT_006b0ec0, /30 to convert ticks to seconds) and broadcasts them with FUN_004ec940(1,0x13,...) followed by FUN_004e1930/FUN_004e1a80, matching the sibling network-sync pattern used elsewhere in this file.
results.summary: Requests or (when mode!=0) formats and broadcasts a network HUD message reporting per-team hill-occupation time in seconds.

results.name: game_engine_multiplayer_sound_network_report
results.evidence: Formats a message via FUN_004ec940(0,0x19,...) and, if in_ECX==-1, broadcasts it with FUN_004e1a80; otherwise checks two flag bits via FUN_004e0810 before sending a targeted FUN_004e1930, matching the mp-sound report pattern used by sibling FUN_0046bd00.
results.summary: Requests/sends a multiplayer-sound status message (event id 0x19) to all machines or a specific one, gated by flags from the sound-target lookup.

results.name: game_engine_multiplayer_sound_update_carrier
results.evidence: When *in_EAX==0, checks FUN_004ec590 and looks up an entry in the reflexive table at DAT_00746fa0+0x168 (count +0x5c, array +0x60) keyed by in_ECX before calling FUN_00543dd0(1.0); otherwise defers to FUN_004ec670, mirroring the identical lookup in FUN_0046bd00.
results.summary: Checks whether a pending flag is unset and a valid multiplayer-sound table entry exists for the given index, and if so triggers local sound playback (FUN_00543dd0); otherwise clears/defers via FUN_004ec670.

results.name: game_engine_play_multiplayer_sound
results.evidence: Validates a sound index (in_EAX) against the reflexive table at DAT_00746fa0+0x168, optionally reports it over the network via FUN_0046bbd0 when param_1=='\x01', then calls FUN_00543dd0(1.0) once the entry (and, in team play, datum_get) confirms validity.
results.summary: Validates a multiplayer sound index and, once confirmed valid, optionally networks the event and then triggers full-volume local playback.

results.name: game_engine_multiplayer_sound_queue_tick
results.evidence: Decrements a per-slot delay counter (DAT_006b10f8); once it hits zero, shifts the 5-slot queue (DAT_006b10f0/10f4/10f8/10fc) left by one and calls FUN_0046bd00(DAT_006b10fc) to dispatch the next queued sound.
results.summary: Per-tick handler for the delayed multiplayer-sound queue: counts down the currently playing entry and, once it expires, advances the queue and plays the next scheduled sound.

results.name: game_engine_get_multiplayer_sound_duration_ticks
results.evidence: Looks up sound index in_EAX in the reflexive table at DAT_00746fa0+0x168 (count +0x5c, array +0x60, stride 0x10, tag ref at +0xc), then reads the tag definition's field +0x84 (via DAT_0087bc14) and converts it from milliseconds to ticks (*30/1000).
results.summary: Returns, in game ticks, the playback duration of the multiplayer announcer sound identified by the index passed in EAX.

results.name: game_engine_queue_multiplayer_sound
results.evidence: Forces param_1=0 outside team play, and if DAT_00688328[index] is set, pushes a new entry (delay = FUN_0046bde0()+5, flag=param_1) onto the 5-slot queue used by FUN_0046bd80, dispatching immediately via FUN_0046bd00 when it becomes the only entry; otherwise calls FUN_0046bd00 directly.
results.summary: Schedules a multiplayer announcer sound to play once any currently-queued sounds finish, or plays it immediately for sound types that do not support queuing.

results.name: game_engine_koth_find_random_hill_location
results.evidence: Calls game_engine_find_valid_starting_locations(0,0,2,in_CX,1,&local_10) for a type-2 spawn location, and on failure falls back to randomly selecting (via the DAT_00719cd0 LCG) among the scenario's type-2 starting locations (DAT_00746f8c+0x378/0x37c), returning the chosen position through param_1.
results.summary: Finds a valid (or, failing that, a random) type-2 scenario starting location and returns its position, used to place the King-of-the-Hill marker.

results.name: game_engine_koth_move_hill_marker
results.evidence: Reads the current hill-marker object (DAT_00746fa0+0x168 base, field +0x58), detaches it via FUN_004f53a0(idx,-1), computes a new random valid position via FUN_0046beb0, obtains/updates a marker object with FUN_004f5460 and clears a status bit, spawning it through FUN_004f50f0 when needed.
results.summary: Relocates the moving King-of-the-Hill marker: detaches the current hill object, picks a new valid random position, and (re)spawns the marker there.

results.name: game_engine_koth_relocate_hill_for_object
results.evidence: In team play, resolves an object via DAT_008603b0, calls FUN_0046beb0 to get a new hill position, optionally queues a sound (FUN_0046be40(1)) when DAT_006f1d18<3, calls FUN_004666c0, and clears bit 0x40 of the object's flags at +0x22c.
results.summary: In team play, finds a new hill location for the given object index, plays a related sound when few hills have been used, and clears the object's 'needs relocation' flag.

results.name: game_engine_koth_team_tick_update
results.evidence: Increments per-player (DAT_006b118c) and per-team-hill (DAT_006b114c, keyed by player-table field +0x20) occupancy counters in team play, fires FUN_0046be40(1) at 900/0x708-tick remaining thresholds, and calls game_engine_begin_end_game_sequence() once the counter reaches the fixed target DAT_006b1148.
results.summary: Alternate per-tick King-of-the-Hill scorer that increments per-player and per-team hill-occupancy counters against a fixed target and triggers the end-of-game sequence once that target is met.

results.name: game_engine_koth_update_hill_occupant_table
results.evidence: Clears any slot in the fixed-size table DAT_006b120c..DAT_006b124c equal to unaff_ESI, then resolves the corresponding object via DAT_008603b0/DAT_0087bc14 and, if a specific tag-definition flag bit (>>3&1) is set, re-registers unaff_ESI into the slot indexed by the object's owner field (puVar4[0x2e]).
results.summary: Removes an index from all slots of the hill-occupant tracking table, then re-adds it under its owning team's slot if the associated object's tag supports it.

results.name: game_engine_koth_update_player_hill_multiplier_and_score
results.evidence: Calls FUN_0046c320 to refresh the occupant table, counts how many of DAT_006f1d18 occupant slots equal param_1, sets a score-multiplier field (+0x6c) to 1.0/1.25/0.75 based on DAT_006f1d08, applies FUN_0046c230 that many times, and updates a per-team seconds-in-hill counter with FUN_0046be40 fired every 150 ticks.
results.summary: Dispatches the King-of-the-Hill per-tick scoring for a player across however many hill slots they occupy, applying a configurable score multiplier and periodic sound cues.

results.name: game_engine_koth_check_hill_timeout
results.evidence: Compares elapsed ticks since the hill object's last-active timestamp (param_2+0x204) to a ~20s threshold (0x4b0); in team play, on timeout it broadcasts a chimera__kill_feed(id 0x26) message and relocates the hill via FUN_0046c1a0, otherwise it updates the per-slot last-active timestamp array DAT_006b124c.
results.summary: Checks whether a hill has gone unclaimed for too long and, if so, announces it via the kill feed and relocates it; otherwise records the current tick as the hill's last-active time.

results.name: game_engine_koth_can_player_score
results.evidence: In team-style configurations (DAT_006f1d14 in {1,2}), immediately notifies via FUN_00460c10(...,0x20,0x21,0x22,...) and returns true; otherwise checks the player's hill assignment validity and defers to FUN_00570520(3), setting the object's 0x40 flag bit when scoring should be blocked.
results.summary: Determines whether a player is currently eligible to score hill time, using different rules for team versus non-team hill configurations.

results.name: game_engine_koth_sync_variant_state
results.evidence: Mirrors FUN_0046b7f0's request/response network pattern (FUN_004ec940 event id 0x12) but transmits a larger block of per-hill/team counters (DAT_006b1148.. 81 dwords, some divided by 30 to convert ticks to seconds) before broadcasting via FUN_004e1930/FUN_004e1a80.
results.summary: Requests or broadcasts the King-of-the-Hill variant's team score/target state over the network, converting tick counts to seconds where needed.

results.name: game_engine_find_nearest_free_start_location
results.evidence: Scans the scenario's type-4 starting-location entries (DAT_00746f8c+0x378/0x37c), skipping indices already present in the param_1 list, and returns the index nearest to unaff_EBX by squared distance, or the first free one if unaff_EBX is null.
results.summary: Finds the nearest (or, if no reference point is given, the first) unused type-4 scenario starting location, excluding indices already claimed.

results.name: game_engine_assign_unique_start_location_ids
results.evidence: For scenario starting locations of type 3, ensures the per-entry id field (+0x12) is unique within [0,0x1f] by reassigning any collision to the next free bit of a 32-bit used-id bitmask.
results.summary: Assigns each type-3 scenario starting location (used for CTF-style flag stands) a unique slot id in the range 0-31, resolving any duplicates.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_initialize_flags
results.evidence: String hint 'flag_blue' plus code: calls FUN_0046d800 to assign flag-slot ids, resets per-flag runtime arrays (DAT_006f1888.., DAT_0087a520..) for every type-3 location, and depending on the CTF sub-mode (DAT_006f1d04: per-team vs neutral) either pre-assigns each team's flag or randomly selects the starting flag via FUN_0046dfe0.
results.summary: Initializes the Capture-the-Flag subsystem for a new round: assigns unique flag ids, resets each flag's runtime state, and configures per-team or neutral flag assignment depending on the active CTF sub-mode.

results.name: game_engine_update_scores_and_check_win_condition
results.evidence: Aggregates a per-bucket value (min/max/sum selected by DAT_006f1d08) from all active players/objects (bucket = field+0x20, 0..15) into DAT_006b1318[], then in team play checks each bucket against target DAT_006f1ce0 and, when reached before DAT_0087aa10 (winner-declared) is set, arms a countdown, queues the win sound via the multiplayer sound queue, clears kill-feed/network buffers, and broadcasts a game-ending HUD message (event id 0x16).
results.summary: Aggregates per-bucket (team/hill/flag) score values each tick and, once any bucket reaches its target, declares a winner, arms the end-of-round countdown, plays the win announcement, and broadcasts a game-over message.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_on_flag_captured
results.evidence: Clears the flag's captured bit (DAT_006b12d4[idx]=0), queues a sound (FUN_0046be40(1)), computes and records a new capture time versus the stored best (field +0xc4 vs +200), calls the score/win-check FUN_0046db70, dispatches a mode-specific HUD announcement via FUN_00460c10, and broadcasts a 'new record' kill-feed message when a record was set.
results.summary: Handles a completed flag capture: clears the flag's carried state, updates and checks the capture-time record, runs the score/win check, and announces the capture (and any new record) to all players.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_is_flag_eligible
results.evidence: Cross-references the captured-flags bitmask DAT_006b12d4[idx] against the enabled-flags mask DAT_006b1290 and, depending on the CTF sub-mode DAT_006f1d04 and the per-slot time limit DAT_006f1ce0, decides whether flag id unaff_EDI is currently the valid one for slot idx.
results.summary: Determines whether a given flag id is the one currently eligible to be captured for a particular team/slot, accounting for the active CTF sub-mode.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_pick_random_flag
results.evidence: Counts the active flag bits in DAT_006b1290 (excluding param_1 if valid), then uses the game's LCG (DAT_00719cd0) to randomly choose one of the scenario's type-3 flag-stand locations other than param_1, returning its assigned slot id.
results.summary: Randomly selects one of the active flag locations (excluding the given one) for neutral/single-flag CTF play.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_on_flag_scored
results.evidence: Validates flag eligibility via FUN_0046df30, queues a score sound, records the team's first-assigned flag (DAT_006b1294), and either completes the capture via FUN_0046dde0 (+FUN_0046dfe0 for neutral mode) or marks the flag's bit in the multi-flag bitmask DAT_006b12d4 until all required flags are captured.
results.summary: Processes a flag being scored for a team: validates eligibility, updates per-team flag bookkeeping, and completes the capture once all required flags (in multi-flag mode) or the single flag (in neutral mode) have been taken.

results.name: game_engine_can_score_bucket
results.evidence: Returns true immediately if DAT_006f1d08!=0; otherwise scans active objects assigned to bucket param_1 whose per-object counter (+0xc6) is under the time limit DAT_006f1ce0 and whose type-definition slot count (0x1fffeae) has reached DAT_006f1cd8, returning false to block further scoring when found.
results.summary: Checks whether additional scoring/assignment is currently allowed for a given bucket (team/hill/flag slot), blocking it once a configured capacity limit has been reached.

results.name: game_engine_update_leaderboard_highlight_weights
results.evidence: Finds the maximum per-object 'last scored' tick (field +0xc6) across all active objects, then sets each object's highlight-weight field (+0x6c) to 1.0 for the most recent and ~1.1/1.2 for others based on how far behind it is (divided by 3 in mode DAT_006f1d04==2).
results.summary: Computes a per-object HUD highlight/pulse weight based on how recently each object last scored relative to the current leader.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_sync_flag_state
results.evidence: Uses the same query/broadcast network pattern (FUN_004ec940 event id 0x14, FUN_004e1930/FUN_004e1a80) as the KOTH sync functions, but transmits/receives the CTF flag bitmasks and per-team assignment arrays (DAT_006b1290, DAT_006b1294/1298.., DAT_006b12d4/12d8) established by FUN_0046d890/FUN_0046e080.
results.summary: Requests or broadcasts the current Capture-the-Flag state (active flags, per-team assignments, and captured bitmasks) over the network.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_reset_flags
results.evidence: String hint 'flag_blue'; gated on team play (DAT_00719720==2), reuses FUN_0046d800 for ids, calls FUN_00462260(0,-1,-1) per type-3 flag location (also seen in FUN_0046c5d0's timeout handler), and reproduces FUN_0046d890's mode0/mode2 per-team flag assignment tail almost verbatim.
results.summary: Re-initializes/returns all Capture-the-Flag flags mid-round in team play, resetting their state and reassigning per-team flags similarly to the full round-start initializer.

results.name: game_engine_ctf_pick_random_teammate_and_clear_reservation
results.evidence: Clears the given player's reservation field (player-table offset +0x88), then, using the two-pass count-then-pick data_iterator_next pattern used elsewhere for RNG selection, randomly chooses another active entry not sharing the player's own bucket/team field (+0x20).
results.summary: Clears a player's pending reservation flag and randomly selects another active player/object outside the player's own team or bucket.

results.name: game_engine_update_hill_icon_pulse
results.evidence: Independently animates two objects' float field +0x6c: one decays toward ~0.9-1.0 by -0.02/tick with a -0.15 wrap, the other grows toward up to 1.5 by +0.1/tick, gated by DAT_006f1d05/DAT_006f1d04.
results.summary: Animates a pair of HUD icon scale/alpha values, one fading down and one growing up over time, consistent with a hill-control pulse indicator.

results.name: game_engine_get_zoom_fov_value
results.evidence: Indexes a per-weapon zoom-level float table (DAT_00746fa0+0x120, validity via +0x11c) by param_1*0x10 + clamped magnification level (in_CX, 0-3)*4, returning 1.0 as a default when the table is unavailable.
results.summary: Looks up the field-of-view value for a given weapon/zoom-table index and magnification level, defaulting to 1.0 if no zoom data is present.

results.name: game_engine_get_zoom_fov_for_weapon
results.evidence: Validates a weapon/index range (in_AX, 0-9) and a bit in the shared team-bitmask table DAT_006b0b84+0xa4, substitutes an index via DAT_00657470, then delegates to FUN_0046fe10 for the actual FOV value.
results.summary: Resolves and validates a zoom-table index before delegating to the zoom FOV lookup, applying a bitmask/substitution check first.

results.name: game_engine_attribute_player_death
results.evidence: Builds a 4-entry recent-damager list (position/time pairs at object+0x430../0x46c) from the victim's object, applies a same-team exclusion using the friendly-fire bitmask (DAT_006b0b84+0xa4), selects the most-recent qualifying damager, and finally calls game_engine_on_player_death(param_2, killer, flags).
results.summary: Determines kill/assist credit for a player's death by scanning the victim's recent-damager history and team relationships before invoking game_engine_on_player_death with the resolved killer.

results.name: game_engine_record_oddball_reset_message
results.evidence: Gated on DAT_006f1d20/DAT_006f1cbc (same enable flags used by the hill-occupancy state machine), scans data_iterator_next for a color/team byte (+0x67), formats a message (FUN_004ec940 event id 0x1a), then writes it into the active film/recording buffer via FUN_004cf8f0 guarded by FUN_004ddb60 capacity checks.
results.summary: Formats an announcer message and serializes it into the game's film/replay buffer so it is reproduced correctly when a saved film is played back.

results.name: game_engine_assign_player_by_color
results.evidence: Scans data_iterator_next entries for one whose byte field +0x67 (team/color id) matches unaff_ESI, then writes unaff_BL into its bucket field +0x20 and mirrors it into +0x66.
results.summary: Finds the active player/object matching a given color id and reassigns its bucket/team index.

results.name: game_engine_set_player_slot_value
results.evidence: Scans a fixed 16-entry, 0x20-byte-stride table (in_ECX+0x1a2) for the entry whose id byte (+0x1f) equals unaff_ESI, swaps its value byte (+0x1e) with unaff_BL, and reports whether the value actually changed.
results.summary: Updates a per-player customization/allegiance slot value in a fixed 16-entry table, returning whether the value changed.

results.name: game_engine_count_players_by_status
results.evidence: Iterates a fixed 16-slot table at DAT_0071c2d4+0x1c8 via FUN_004de9f0, tallying matches (excluding param_2) into two count buckets, and separately fetches two aggregate values via a vtable callback at DAT_006f1d20+0x50 into param_1.
results.summary: Gathers two paired per-side totals (score-like values via a callback, and matching counts from a status table) used by the lead-change comparison helpers.

results.name: game_engine_is_team_leading
results.evidence: Uses FUN_00470690's two paired totals (score-like values, count-like values) to decide whether the first side is ahead, breaking ties on the secondary counts.
results.summary: Determines whether one side is currently leading over the other, using score totals with a count-based tiebreaker.

results.name: game_engine_is_score_margin_close
results.evidence: Using FUN_00470690's per-side totals, computes whether the trailing side's remaining count is within roughly 20% of the leading side's, selected by unaff_EBX (0 or 1).
results.summary: Checks whether the score margin between two sides is close enough (within about 20%) to warrant a close-game notification.

results.name: game_engine_update_lead_change_notification
results.evidence: Validates a color/team slot against the shared table at DAT_0071c2d4 (+0x1c6/+0x1c8), uses FUN_00470790/FUN_00470720 to decide on a leading/close-game state change, updates the tracked state via FUN_004705f0/FUN_00470630, calls FUN_00463620 for the matching active player, then re-broadcasts a message (event id 0x1a) via FUN_004ec940/FUN_004e1a80.
results.summary: Detects a lead change or close-game condition for a given team color, updates the tracked state and HUD indicator, and broadcasts the notification to all clients.

results.name: game_engine_update_player_color_slot
results.evidence: In game mode DAT_00719720==1, when *in_EAX==0 and the enable flags are set, calls FUN_004ec590(0xffff) and then refreshes the per-color slot table via FUN_004705f0/FUN_00470630, otherwise calls FUN_004ec670.
results.summary: Refreshes a player's per-color slot table entry in a specific single-player-like game mode, mirroring the setup step used by the lead-change notification pipeline.

results.name: game_engine_allocate_tick_record
results.evidence: Advances the growing record buffer DAT_006e2dcc by 0x20 bytes, folds the fixed record size into a running CRC via crc32_update, zero-initializes the new record, and publishes it as the current tick record via DAT_006f1d6c (whose field +0xc is used as the running tick counter throughout this file).
results.summary: Allocates and zero-initializes a new per-tick game-state record, updates the running CRC over it, and makes it the current tick record.

results.name: game_engine_init_tick_record
results.evidence: Initializes the newly allocated tick record's time-scale field (+0x18 = 1.0) and accumulator (+0x1c = 0), sets DAT_006f1d49/48, then dispatches to a mode-specific initializer (FUN_00472b70 for modes 0/2, FUN_00472fa0 for modes 1/3) based on DAT_00719720.
results.summary: Initializes the current tick record's time-scale and accumulator fields and performs game-mode-specific setup.

results.name: game_engine_tick_accumulator_advance
results.evidence: Scales elapsed time (param_1) by 30Hz and a time-scale factor (tick record field +0x18, forced to 1.0 in modes 1/2), floors it to a whole-tick count via FUN_00623e40, and (unless param_2 suppresses it) carries the fractional remainder back into the tick record's accumulator field +0x1c, clamped at 0.
results.summary: Implements a fixed-30Hz-timestep accumulator, converting a frame's elapsed time into a whole number of simulation ticks while carrying the fractional remainder forward.

results.name: game_engine_advance_simulation_ticks
results.evidence: Computes the number of simulation ticks to run via FUN_00470b30 (forced to 1 when DAT_007196d8 is set), runs mode-specific pre-tick hooks (FUN_00473310/FUN_004e03c0), steps the simulation that many times via FUN_0045b780 while advancing the tick-record counters (+0xc/+0x14), then calls game_effects_update with a time-scaled delta.
results.summary: Advances the game simulation by the appropriate number of fixed 30Hz ticks for this frame, running per-tick hooks and updating game effects.

results.name: game_engine_get_current_tick
results.evidence: Returns *(undefined4 *)(DAT_006f1d6c + 0xc), the running tick counter field of the current tick record allocated by FUN_00470a80.
results.summary: Returns the current simulation tick count from the active tick record.

results.name: game_engine_get_time_scale
results.evidence: Returns 1.0 in game modes 1/2, otherwise returns the current tick record's time-scale field (+0x18), matching its initialization in FUN_00470ae0.
results.summary: Returns the effective simulation time-scale factor for the current game mode.

results.name: angle_delta_wrapped
results.evidence: Computes param_2-param_1 and wraps the result into (-pi, pi] by adding/subtracting 2*pi, a standard shortest-angle-difference utility with no globals or register artifacts.
results.summary: Computes the shortest signed angular difference between two angles, wrapped to the range (-pi, pi].

results.name: math_move_value_toward_clamped
results.evidence: Clamps the requested delta (param_1 - *in_ECX) to +/-param_2 and applies it to *in_ECX, a rate-limited 'move toward' step used alongside the camera/FOV interpolation helpers in this region.
results.summary: Advances a value pointed to by ECX toward a target by at most a given maximum step per call.

results.name: game_engine_compute_look_angles_from_vector
results.evidence: Computes yaw via fpatan(y,x) and pitch via fpatan(z, sqrt(x^2+y^2)) from a direction vector (in_EAX), storing them into the per-player look record DAT_006b145c[in_CX] at offsets 0xc/0x10 and wrapping yaw into [0, 2*pi).
results.summary: Derives yaw and pitch angles from a 3D direction vector and stores them into the given player's look-state record.

results.name: game_engine_reset_player_look_state
results.evidence: Zeroes and re-defaults the per-player look record DAT_006b145c, including the +-1.4922565 rad pitch-clamp constants reused later by FUN_004710b0, and lazily seeds default turn-rate globals DAT_006f1d74/78 from the multiplayer globals table at DAT_00746fa0+0x114 (fields +0x4c/+0x50).
results.summary: Resets a player's look/aim state record to its defaults, including pitch clamp limits, and initializes global default turn-rate constants on first use.

results.name: game_engine_init_player_look_state_from_object
results.evidence: Resets the look record slot indexed by in_AX and, if in_EDX names a valid object, seeds yaw/pitch from the object's velocity vector (fields +0x224/0x228/0x22c) via fpatan with the same +-1.4922565 pitch clamp, copying additional per-object look-constraint fields (+0x2f4/+0x31d/+0x321).
results.summary: Initializes a specific player's look/aim state record, optionally seeding its initial yaw/pitch and constraints from a given object's facing/velocity.

results.name: math_interpolate_response_curve
results.evidence: Linearly interpolates between two adjacent entries of a float table (unaff_EDI) at fractional index param_1, negating the result to match the sign of param_2; used by FUN_004710b0 for aim-assist sensitivity evaluation.
results.summary: Evaluates a piecewise-linear response curve stored as a float table at a given fractional index, matching the input's sign.

results.name: input_stick_deadzone_sign
results.evidence: Returns 1.0 if param_1 > 0.05, -1.0 if param_1 < -0.05, and 0.0 otherwise -- a simple deadzone/sign helper used by the aim-assist control-data builder FUN_004710b0.
results.summary: Returns the sign of a control-stick axis value outside a small deadzone, or zero within it.

results.name: game_engine_build_aim_assist_control_data
results.evidence: Given a camera/index table (DAT_0087a478), resolves a player and its look record (DAT_006b145c), computes clamped stick deltas via input_stick_deadzone_sign and math_interpolate_response_curve, applies aim-assist scaling from the target's angular velocity/distance, and packs a set of boolean button/state flags into param_3[6], writing the full 8-float result into param_3.
results.summary: Builds an 8-float unit-control-data structure (aim deltas and packed action-button flags) for a given camera/player index, applying aim-assist smoothing toward a target object.
